title: Grow the VM 106 filesystem to fill the disk
runbook:
## Inputs needed

- `<PALWORLD_USER>` — the account inside VM 106 that has sudo (the operator logs in with it)

## Run this

```bash
qm guest exec 106 -- bash -c "sudo growpart /dev/sda 1"
```

```bash
qm guest exec 106 -- bash -c "sudo resize2fs /dev/sda1"
```

## Verify

- Root filesystem reports ~100GB: `qm guest exec 106 -- df -h /`

## Rollback

If growpart fails, the partition table is unchanged — no rollback needed. If resize2fs fails after growpart succeeded, the partition is larger but the filesystem is not; re-run the resize2fs command after checking `qm guest exec 106 -- sudo lsblk` to confirm the partition size.
